article.story: Toledo (3-1) at Ball State (1-3), Oct. 3 at 2 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Toledo by 18.5. Against the spread: Toledo 2-1-1, Ball State 1-3. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Toledo Offense Overall: 468.0 yards per game (27th in FBS) Passing: 305.5 yards per game (15th) Rushing: 162.5 yards per game (66th) Scoring: 43.3 points per game (12th) Toledo Defense Overall: 314.3 yards per game (46th in FBS) Passing: 181.3 yards per game (39th) Rushing: 133.0 yards per game (74th) Scoring: 26.0 points per game (95th) Ball State Offense Overall: 279.5 yards per game (135th in FBS) Passing: 158.3 yards per game (125th) Rushing: 121.3 yards per game (116th) Scoring: 18.0 points per game (129th) Ball State Defense Overall: 453.8 yards per game (135th in FBS) Passing: 254.5 yards per game (118th) Rushing: 199.3 yards per game (127th) Scoring: 37.5 points per game (135th) Ball State is 135th in third down percentage, converting 25.5% of the time. Toledo ranks 56th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 34.9%. Toledo ranks 128th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 100.0% of trips. Ball State's red zone offense ranks 99th, scoring in 80.0% of red zone trips. Toledo ranks 120th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:38. Team leaders Toledo Passing: John Alan Richter, 1,161 yards, 12 TDs, 1 INT, 66.9 completion percentage Rushing: Connor Walendzak, 233 yards on 41 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Bryson Hammer, 286 yards on 15 catches, 2 TDs Ball State Passing: Keldric Luster, 438 yards, 3 TDs, 2 INTs, 64.0 completion percentage Rushing: T.J. Horton, 212 yards on 28 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Donovan Hamilton, 150 yards on 14 catches, 1 TD Last game Toledo won 41-16 over San Diego State on Sept. 26. Richter passed for 284 yards on 16-of-22 attempts (72.7%) with three touchdowns and no interceptions. Autavius Ison had 89 rushing yards on 15 carries. Hammer put up 133 yards on six catches with two touchdowns. Ball State fell to Kent State 26-13 on Sept. 26. Tyler Mizzell led Ball State with 164 yards on 16-of-27 passing (59.3%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Jalen Bonds carried the ball 11 times for 36 yards and scored one touchdown, adding five receptions for 57 yards. Hamilton put up 80 yards on seven catches with one touchdown. Next game Toledo hosts Buffalo on Oct. 10. Ball State plays at Northwestern on Oct. 10.
